text: At its meeting on June 1, 2022, the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee considered item RD5.1 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of CreateTO. Summary from the report May 17, 2022 the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee: This report includes an update on staffing matters, including a snapshot of CreateTO's human resources as at the end of the first quarter 2022.
The Board of Directors of CreateTO: 1. Received the report (May 17, 2022) from the Chief Executive Officer, CreateTO for information.
